post_caption: You chose B: he stayed seated. Something is getting closer. Part 2

beats.title: Stay seated
beats.subtitle: PART 2
beats.say: You chose B. He stays seated. Eyes forward.
The tapping stops. Everything goes quiet.
Too quiet. You can hear breathing. Behind you.

messages.text: now don't move when it sits next to you

beats.say: Good. You didn't look. Now don't move when it sits next to you.
The back row creaks. It's getting up.

beats.text: If it sits next to you, give it your name
beats.say: You flip the card over. Rule four. If it sits next to you, give it your name.
But which name? Your real one... or Mark?

beats.question: Which name do you give it?
beats.say: Your real name? Or Mark? Comment A or B.
